description: Help a sleep-deprived parent consolidate 28 days of messy sleep training notes into a structured spreadsheet analysis. The raw notes (sleep_notes_raw.txt on Desktop) contain inconsistent formatting and emotional annotations. Create a spreadsheet with columns for Date, Method, Night Wakings, Wake Duration (min), and Notes. Calculate average night wakings and duration for each of the three methods (Ferber, Chair, Pick-Up-Put-Down) using AVERAGE formulas. Include a summary section comparing methods and recommending the best approach based on data. Save as sleep_training_analysis.xlsx.
